title: Overwatch 2 Retail Patch Notes - October 30, 2025
title_cn: 《守望先锋2》正式服补丁说明 - 2025年10月30日
note:
### Overwatch 2 Retail Patch Notes - October 30, 2025

#### Stadium

Competitive Update

General

* Stadium Competitive has been reverted back to the best of 7 format.
* Powers are granted on rounds 1, 3, 5 and 7
* The first team that wins 4 rounds will win the match
* The mercy rule has been renabled
* Round 1 completion cash decreased to 5000 (Down from 10000)
* Round 2 completion cash decreased to 4000 (Down from 7500)
* Round complete cash decreased to 3500 (Down from 5000)
* The amount of cash generated each round from healing and damage has been decreased
* MVP bonus decreased to 1000 (Down from 1500)
* Bounty Increase per Elimination decreased to 75 (from 100)

We are reverting the format of Ranked Stadium back to best of 7. This is a direct result of both player feedback and internal data. Best of 7 provides players with more space to let their builds breathe and of course, make those incredible comebacks! Thank you for all of the thoughtful feedback.
note_cn:
### 《守望先锋2》正式服补丁说明 - 2025年10月30日

#### 角斗领域

竞技模式更新

综合

* “角斗领域”竞技模式已恢复为七局四胜制。
* 第1、3、5和7回合将发放强化能力。
* 率先赢得4个回合的队伍将获得比赛胜利。
* 重新启用了仁慈规则。
* 第1回合完成金币减少至5000（从10000下调）。
* 第2回合完成金币减少至4000（从7500下调）。
* 回合完成金币减少至3500（从5000下调）。
* 每个回合通过治疗和伤害获取的金币数量已减少。
* MVP奖励减少至1000（从1500下调）。
* 每次消灭增加的赏金减少至75（从100下调）。

我们将“角斗领域”竞技模式的赛制恢复为七局四胜制。这是基于玩家反馈和内部数据做出的直接调整。七局四胜制能为玩家提供更多空间来让他们的构建成型，当然，也能创造那些不可思议的翻盘局！感谢大家提供的所有宝贵反馈。
